tools.name: genos_orchestrate
tools.description: Launch or continue an autonomous GenOS mission. Decomposes tasks, coordinates workers, and produces verified claims.

mission.description: Goal or user request to achieve.

strategy.description: Optional strategy hint from the 78 available.

background.description: True to run detached in the background.

tools.name: genos_delegate_worker
tools.description: Delegate an isolated bounded sub-task to a GenOS worker inside a dedicated capsule.

tools.name: genos_snapshot
tools.description: Create an immutable content-addressed checkpoint of the workspace.

agent.description: Path to the agent genome input.

out.description: Output path for the snapshot JSON.

tools.name: genos_replay
tools.description: Replay a validated snapshot and return its reproduction receipt.

snapshot.description: Snapshot path relative to the GenOS workspace root.

tools.name: genos_capsule_create
tools.description: Provision an isolated copy-on-write execution capsule from a snapshot.

tools.name: genos_execute_primitive
tools.description: Execute one of the 97 GenOS strategic primitives directly with telemetry and verification.

primitive_name.description: Name of the primitive (e.g. mcts_select, stdp_update).

tools.name: genos_change_strategy
tools.description: Switch active strategy portfolio at any runtime decision gate based on empirical evidence.

tools.name: genos_report_progress
tools.description: Report concise milestone progress or blocker update to the orchestrator and user.

tools.name: genos_change_organization
tools.description: Modify the communication and routing topology of the agent collective.

tools.name: genos_organization_state
tools.description: Read the active organization topology, permissions, and visible communication links.

tools.name: genos_worker_publish
tools.description: Publish evidence, hypotheses, or biomimetic signals to peer workers through enforced routing.

tools.name: genos_worker_inbox
tools.description: Retrieve messages and evidence visible to this worker under the current topology.

tools.name: genos_trinity_launch
tools.description: Deploy Trinity worlds for deep comparative exploration.

tools.name: genos_a_team_preview
tools.description: Compose a multidisciplinary A-Team for a mission.

tools.name: genos_biological_mode
tools.description: Deploy a Biome, Syncytium, Holobiont, Biocenosis, Rhizome, or Metapopulation collective for a mission.

tools.name: genos_merge
tools.description: Merge an isolated branch under invariants.

tools.name: genos_audit
tools.description: Audit a snapshot or lineage trace.

tools.name: genos_biomimicry
tools.description: Invoke a native biomimetic feature.

tools.name: genos_v2_init
tools.description: Initialize GenOS workspace state.

tools.name: genos_v2_fork
tools.description: Fork workspace state into an isolated branch.

tools.name: genos_swe_fault_localizer
tools.description: Proprioceptive codebase scanner and NER fault localization for SWE-bench (Sherrington proprioception + MutS/UvrA mismatch detector).

candidate_files.description: Optional list of candidate file paths.

max_candidates.description: Maximum number of candidate files to return.

tools.name: genos_swe_surgical_repair
tools.description: Biomimetic NER DNA excision repair and minimal blast radius patch synthesis (UvrBC dual-incision endonuclease).

max_blast_radius.description: Maximum allowed blast radius risk score.

tools.name: genos_swe_verify_patch
tools.description: Cerebellar motor error feedback and p53 checkpoint verification for SWE-bench (dry-run sandbox, py_compile syntax, test execution).

test_command.description: Reproduction test command to execute in sandbox.

tools.name: genos_browser_act
tools.description: Interactive semantic web browser navigation and download ingestion for GAIA 77% open-web challenges.

tools.name: genos_foveal_crop
tools.description: Active human foveal vision crop and multi-scale inspection for complex documents, plots, and figures.

image_path.description: Path to the image or document page.

region.description: Bounding box coordinates {x, y, width, height}.

tools.name: genos_optimal_foraging
tools.description: Charnov marginal value theorem and stigmergic scout-harvester coordination across open web sources.

current_patch.description: Current web resource or domain being exploited.

candidate_patches.description: Candidate alternate patches to jump to.
